details:
i believe this is an issue only in VR, because afaik you can't have your camera and the small menu opened on dektop at the same time.

when you click the buttons in the small menu, in the camera tab, you change your camera to chosen mode, and spawn it if it's not yet present. (and hide the small menu)

similarly, when you use camera's menu (the lists under/next to it) you can change its modes in an even larger range.

when you open the small menu again, you can see the active camera mode by an "X" on that mode's button, signifying that pressing that button again will delete/hide the camera.

this logic works with

- the "photo camera" button, which changes the camera into the "local photo" mode,

- "stream camera" button / "stream" mode, and

- "multi layer camera" button / "multi layer" mode.

however, the remaining 2 buttons/their respective modes: "gallery" and "print" don't work properly.

- "gallery camera" button doesn't turn "local photo" mode into "gallery photo" mode (it does, however, turn other modes into that)

- "gallery" mode shows the 'X" in the small menu as if the "local photo" mode was active - on the "photo camera" button

- pressing "photo camera" (which has the X) while the "gallery" mode is active turns the camera off instead of switching into the "local photo" mode.

- "print" mode does not show in the menu at all -there's no button with the "X" marker to close it, and thus you can't close it this way

reported for build 1629, but seems to be also the case in the beta, both build 1642 and the just released 1643
title: Active camera mode not always displayed and working properly in the menu
